sloka: रोषेण महता आविष्टाः पीडयन् मिथिलाम् पुरीम् ।ततः संवत्सरे पूर्णे क्षयम् यातानि सर्वशः ॥१-६६-२२॥
transliteration: roṣeṇa mahatā āviṣṭāḥ pīḍayan mithilām purīm ।tataḥ saṁvatsare pūrṇe kṣayam yātāni sarvaśaḥ ॥1-66-22॥

translations.english: O Best among ascetics thus one year passed. Everywhere in the city all the means of living were exhausted. I felt deeply sad over this situation.
